elements.name: old boxy country bus seen from its side
young man seen from behind in the centre facing the open door
low houses with rusty corrugated tin roofs and mud-plastered walls
high bright sun with short shadows

notes: Repaint the ragged white paper edges at the bottom-left and right so the painting reaches every edge, and make the sandals read clearly as closed-toe moulded plastic with a buckle strap.
